gap_statement: No served source carries per-account AUM for a billing period, the fee rate, the fee charged and a paid status. The pieces are split across sources: AUM (BD allocations weekly), schedule rate and fee lines (BD fees), debits (Schwab fact_trn), and none carries status. The paid status exists in no object. ADVI_BILLING (Q-2) is the project that would have to produce a scheduled per-account billing object (its AB-t-1 object is one household, one quarter, written once). Until it does, FWD-19 for billing is not done and no reader is built.
